newsitem.title: CHINA: Moody's raises CITIC Pacific unit.
newsitem.headline: Moody's raises CITIC Pacific unit.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Tuesday that it had raised the long-term senior debt rating of CITIC Pacific Finance Ltd, guaranteed by CITIC Pacific Ltd, to Baa1 from Baa2.
CITIC Pacific Finance is wholly owned by CITIC Pacific and is a Cayman Islands incorporated financing vehicle.

Moody's said its action reflected CITIC Pacific's greater focus on synergy from its existing operations and expertise, the company's relatively low leverage through the course of its restructurings, and the increasing cash flow streams that its many infrastructure projects in China are generating.

The rating agency also noted the unpredictability and high operating risks of the companies' activities in mainland China, as well as some remaining uncertainty as to the ultimate control and the general governance of CITIC Pacific.
